copy_notes: All copy is quoted from source files: reel captions/VO from reel-kit/reels.json (VO audio tags like [warm] stripped), feed copy from feed-static.html, Mark copy from mark-corner/ad.html, carousel from new-bond-people/carousel.html, primary texts from checklist/creative/blog/meta-primary-texts.md, WhatsApp header copy from whatsapp-kit/profile/card.html. HEADLINE: meta-primary-texts.md has no Meta headline field and no headline is recorded anywhere in the handovers, so 'headline' is null; use the on-creative headline (feed[].headline_on_creative) if a headline is needed. CTA: the primary texts' CTA line is 'Book a 30-minute call with an authorised adviser on WhatsApp.'; the reel end-card button reads 'Send us a WhatsApp'; the feed statics' button reads 'Book a 30-minute call'; the Meta button label for the click-to-WhatsApp ads is not recorded in the sources. Live chat template on the ads: 'SMC CTWA - Lindi greeting - check my life cover' (HANDOVER-2026-10-17-EVENING.md). 17 Oct rules applied to every final asset: no 'AI-generated' label, no price line ('The call costs you nothing' removed; trust line is now 'Name and FSP number upfront'). NEW-BOND HOOK MISMATCH: reel/feed/primary text say 'Bond approved. One more question.'; the Mark-corner static says 'Bond approved. One more item for the list.' (matches the live landing H1 per meta-primary-texts.md notes). DISCLOSURE: primary texts end 'SortMyCover is not an FSP; it arranges introductions to an authorised adviser.' (the source flags 'arranges' as a possible reviewer concern; alternative wording offered there). READ-MORE URLs (/learn/...) 404 until the redesign zip is uploaded to Hostinger. Reel durations are the source container durations; the silent copies' video track is ~0.1 s shorter (AAC tail). Two silent reels were encoded at CRF 27/28 instead of 26 to stay under 6 MB (new-bond CRF 28, salary-stops CRF 27). Do not caption the people as real customers: all reel/static/learn imagery is generated (Higgsfield / Google Flow).
